notes.title: Star Trek: Resurgence // Enhancement Update
notes.content:
You asked, and we listened! The Resurgence [b]Enhancement Update[/b] is now on Steam with new features to enhance your experience aboard the [i]USS Resolute[/i].

[list]
[*] Achievements Engaged: Show off your skills and dedication with all-new achievements.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Choose from four graphics pre-sets: Minimum, Standard, High, and Maximum – tailor your game visuals to your taste and your system’s performance capabilities.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Take control of V-Sync: Toggle it on or off to find the perfect balance of smoothness and performance.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Enjoy enhanced performance across the board, including a smoother experience on Steam Deck.
[/list]

Your ongoing feedback is invaluable, and we can’t wait to hear what you think of these enhancements.

[b]Please note[/b]: Achievements can only be acquired via a NEW play-through of the game. So, now's the chance to make some different decisions to see what will happen to you and your crewmates aboard the Resolute! 

LLAP - The ST: R team

notes.title: A Captain's Edition, A 20% Discount, A Virtual Tour and A Spock Interview!
notes.content:
Star Trek: Resurgence drops out of warp and onto Steam in One Week (May 23)!

And we have some announcements! 

- Dramatic Labs is excited to offer a special [b]Captain's Edition[/b] alongside the standard version of the game. It includes a [b]digital art book[/b] brimming with over 100 pages of concept art and developer notes (in English and German). Plus, you'll get the [b]original soundtrack[/b] featuring ten epic pieces of music, specially remastered by composer Jared Emerson-Johnson and performed by a live orchestra.

- Prepare for a discount worthy of the Ferengi Commerce Guild!  Both the standard and Captain's Editions will be available on Steam with a [b]launch week discount of 20%[/b], valid until May 30th. That means you can snag the standard edition for US$19.99 and the Captain's Edition for US$23.99 (or your regional equivalent).

- We've heard your requests loud and clear! We're beaming a new feature your way - a brand-new [b]virtual tour of the USS Resolute[/b] accessed via the game menu!  Explore iconic locations including the bridge, sickbay, and the brig - all meticulously designed to bring our Centaur-class refit to life.

- We’ve interviewed Piotr Michael, [b]the voice of Ambassador Spock[/b]. It still astounds us when he pays homage to Leonard Nimoy’s singular voice - we hope you have the same reaction that we do (there’s also a cheeky Kirk moment in there too!) 

[previewyoutube=juT40H8G2FE;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

So - are you ready to boldly go?  Wishlist Star Trek: Resurgence today and prepare to leave Spacedock on May 23rd!
